mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, parent_id, ancestors, region_code, region_name, region_level, sort_no, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_region WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_region WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' ORDER BY region_level ASC, sort_no ASC, region_code ASC
SELECT FROM sys_region WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND (id = #{rootRegionId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{rootRegionId}, ancestors)) ORDER BY region_level ASC, sort_no ASC, region_code ASC

SELECT FROM sys_region
ORDER BY region_level ASC, sort_no ASC, region_code ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT FROM sys_region WHERE region_code = #{regionCode} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_region WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, region_code ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_tenant t INNER JOIN sys_region r ON r.id = t.root_region_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND (r.id = #{regionId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{regionId}, r.ancestors))
